A FEW THINGS YOU MAY BE WONDERING

Let’s make
things clear.

Where does BackHome offer support?

BackHome is focused on Hyderabad. The exact location and requirements of each task will be checked before it is accepted.

Can you help with a one-time task?

Yes. A single errand, property visit, or document follow-up can be discussed as a standalone request. Ongoing support can be scoped separately.

How much does it cost?

Pricing depends on the task, location, time, and any third-party costs. A scope and quote need to be agreed before work begins.

Will I need to provide authorization?

Some tasks require your written consent, identity verification, or formal authorization. Requirements depend on the institution and the work involved. Share only the information needed for an agreed task.

Is BackHome an emergency or professional advice service?

No. BackHome provides practical assistance and coordination. Medical emergencies need local emergency services. Legal, financial, and medical advice should come from appropriately qualified professionals.
